summary: Josh Lloyd and Joe Mullinax of Locked On Grizzlies preview the 2026-27 Memphis Grizzlies after the team traded Ja Morant and Jaren Jackson Jr. and drafted Cameron Boozer third overall. They expect Cameron Boozer (about 32 minutes) and Cedric Coward (over 30) to be the only players above 30 minutes a night in Tuomas Iisalo's deep, short-stint rotation. Zach Edey should be ready for opening night but will likely be limited to about 25 to 28 minutes and around 65 games. Ty Jerome is the projected starting point guard at about 27 to 28 minutes, with lower usage than last season. Jerami Grant could bounce back as a scorer and is also a possible trade chip. Jaylen Wells is seen as a bench player. Joe predicts low to mid 30s wins. Josh likes Boozer in drafts, sees Edey and Coward as late-round fliers, and calls Jerome a solid piece.
